names.note: Read out of saint.gr’s heading «Άγιος Αύδακτος και Καλλισθένη η θυγατέρα του».
Read out of doxologia.ro’s line „Sfântul Mucenic Audact” for 4 octombrie.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 566, «Давикт (Адавкт) Ефесский, Мелитинский, мч.», with the rank word left off, the parenthesised second form of the name and the second place left to this note.

death.note: A reign rather than a year, which is what the source gives: days.pravoslavie.ru's 4 октября ст. ст. prints «Мчч. Давикта (Адавкта) (ок. 305-313)». The folder held no date at all before this reading.

source.note: The rank is the alt text of the icon the page sets over the group of lines this one stands in, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all.

attestations.note: The Russian gives this folder its first date, as a reign rather than a year, and two forms of the name: «Давикта (Адавкта)». Its index of names adds a second place, «Давикт (Адавкт) Ефесский, Мелитинский» — of Ephesus and of Melitene.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 4 Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Αύδακτος και Καλλισθένη η θυγατέρα του»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs’s page for 4. октобар ст. ст. (civil 17 October) was not read (2026-09-17).
